summary: Verified the new OFFICE Service Case drawer 'Calibration certificate' block for SVC-00001. Backend office cert endpoint returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (121,511 bytes). Frontend drawer renders drawer-calibration-cert with PASS pill, and both View + Download buttons; Download successfully triggers a file save as calibration-SVC-00001.pdf. Marketing/login pages render fine (regression clean).
critical_code_review_comments: View button opens window.open(url) - Chrome may block popup when clicked programmatically in some flows; consider using <a href target=_blank> for stricter compliance. In our test the popup was created (page.expect_popup fired) though domcontentloaded didn't complete within 10s (PDF viewer). Not a blocker.

seed_data_creation: None - used pre-seeded SVC-00001 case with calibration_captured=true
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cases list is at /service-desk with sidebar 'Cases' link (not /service-desk/cases which is 404). Case drawer opens via clicking the SVC-xxx text row.
